value: What AI approaches are used in mathematics teaching and learning, and how is this literature distributed by country, methodology, publication year and theme?
A PRISMA-guided synthesis of 20 journal articles (2017-2021) mapping which AI approaches are used in mathematics education, where the studies were done, with what methods, and around which themes.

quote: A systematic literature review (SLR) was conducted using established and robust guidelines.

The findings of the SLR indicate that AI approach used in mathematics education for the samples studied were through robotics, systems, tools, teachable agent, autonomous agent, and a comprehensive approach.
The goal of this review is to add to the conversation by offering a complete overview of AI in mathematics teaching and learning for students at all levels of education.
